question: Where was the Paramhans Mandali formed in the year 1840 to eradicate the Caste System?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Bombay**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Paramhans Mandali** was a secret socio-religious group founded in **1840**.
 
• The primary objective of the Paramhans Mandali was to **eradicate the caste system** and promote social equality.
 
• It was founded in **Bombay** (now Mumbai).
 
• Paramhans Mandali was one of the **earliest reform movements** in India.
 
• The group was influenced by the **Bhakti movement** and emphasized the oneness of God and equality of all human beings.
 
• The members of Paramhans Mandali practiced **inter-caste dining** and rejected caste-based distinctions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Delhi**__

 __
 
• **Delhi** is the capital city of India.
 
• It has been a significant center for various political and historical events in India.
 
• Delhi was not the founding place of the **Paramhans Mandali**.
 
 
 
• **Calcutta**__
 __
 
• **Calcutta** (now Kolkata) was a major centre for the **Bengal Renaissance**.
 
• The city played a crucial role in the **Indian freedom struggle**.
 
• Calcutta was not associated with the establishment of the **Paramhans Mandali**.
 
 
 
• **Murshidabad**__
 
 
• **Murshidabad** is a historical city in **West Bengal**.
 
• It was the capital of the **Bengal Subah** during the Mughal period.
 
• Murshidabad is not related to the formation of the **Paramhans Mandali**.
